breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the correct grid specification for a periodic domain from the detailed instructions in section 7 of the prompt ('dx=1/Nx'). It ignored the contradictory and incorrect instruction from the preamble ('interpret Nx as the number of grid points including both endpoints... and set dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)'). The generated specification correctly states 'dx=1/Nx', which aligns with the ground truth that resolved the conflict by removing the incorrect instruction.
